title: Parametric open CAD: RAS tongue
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Manufacturers and labs need 3D interface geometry. Full public disclosure also strengthens the defensive publication. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Model the RAS tongue in a scriptable open CAD tool (CadQuery or FreeCAD Python), parameterised from ras-latch.md, with STEP/STL exports and a dimensioned drawing.
acceptanceCriteria: Parameter table matches ras-latch.md; deviations listed
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
